us.description: 503 security records read from an external S&P 500 dataset snapshot, plus the named major-US additions. Multiple share classes mean security count differs from company count.

tw.description: Manually curated metadata for 284 known TWSE ordinary-stock identities. This is a common-stock search seed, not an official complete/current TWSE listing snapshot.

names_and_aliases.description: Manually curated common Chinese/English company names, short codes, and aliases are merged with public company identity facts.

field_policy.name_zh: Chinese common name when curated; otherwise the source English name is a transparent display fallback.
field_policy.name_full_zh: Empty string when a complete legal Chinese name has not been verified; never invent a translation.
field_policy.name_en: Known English company name, or the public source Security label. Some source labels are short names rather than complete legal names.
field_policy.quotes: This file has no prices, indicators, current membership guarantee, or generated trading signals.

refresh: python scripts/refresh_stock_metadata.py --market all; then regenerate embedded HTML search assets with the project synchronization script.
caveat: Metadata supports offline identification only. Constituents, tickers and company names can change; use the refresh command in a network-enabled environment before relying on current universe coverage.
